scene: A gentleman's home, modest but respectable, with simple furnishings. The wedding ceremony has just concluded inside. The house shows signs of a recent celebration.
action: The gentleman stands beside his new bride as the ceremony concludes. The stepmother looks upon her new stepdaughter with disdain.
caption: "No sooner were the ceremonies of the wedding over but the mother-in-law began to show herself."

scene: Inside the gentleman's house, the stepmother's two daughters sit idly. They are of her own humor, exactly like her in all things.
action: The two daughters sit idly, mirroring their mother's proud and haughty demeanor.
caption: "She had, by a former husband, two daughters of her own humor, who were, indeed, exactly like her in all things."

scene: Inside the gentleman's house, the stepmother's two daughters sit idly while Cinderella works. The home has comfortable rooms for the stepmother's children but bare spaces for Cinderella.
action: The stepmother directs Cinderella to hard labor while her own daughters relax.
caption: "She could not bear the good qualities of this pretty girl, and the less because they made her own daughters appear the more odious."

scene: The kitchen of the gentleman's house, grimy with pots and dishes needing to be scrubbed. Steam rises from the basin where Cinderella works.
action: Cinderella scrubs dishes, tables, and the chamber floors.
caption: "She employed her in the meanest work of the house: she scoured the dishes, tables, etc."

scene: The stepmother's chamber and the sisters' chambers, elegant with fine furnishings and large looking-glasses. The floors are all inlaid with wood.
action: Cinderella scrubs madam's chamber and those of the misses, her sisters.
caption: "She scrubbed madam's chamber, and those of misses, her daughters."

scene: A sorry garret at the top of the house, dusty and cold, with a wretched straw bed on the floor. Dim light filters through a small window.
action: Cinderella lies down on the straw bed after her long day of work.
caption: "She lay up in a sorry garret, upon a wretched straw bed."

scene: The sisters' fine rooms, bright and elegant with floors all inlaid. Their beds are of the very newest fashion with looking-glasses so large they might see themselves full length.
action: The sisters lie in their fine beds, resting comfortably.
caption: "Her sisters lay in fine rooms, with floors all inlaid, upon beds of the very newest fashion."

scene: The chimney-corner of the kitchen, where ashes and cinders have gathered. Cinderella sits among the cinders, her face smudged with soot.
action: Cinderella sits among cinders and ashes after finishing her work.
caption: "She used to go into the chimney-corner, and sit down among cinders and ashes."

scene: The same chimney-corner, with Cinderella seated in the ashes. Despite her sooty appearance, she is visibly beautiful beneath the grime.
action: Cinderella sits quietly, her beauty evident even through her mean apparel.
caption: "Cinderella, notwithstanding her mean apparel, was a hundred times handsomer than her sisters."

scene: The gentleman's house, the stepmother governing her husband entirely. The father stands passively while his wife commands.
action: The stepmother governs her husband entirely.
caption: "The poor girl bore all patiently, and dared not tell her father, who would have rattled her off; for his wife governed him entirely."

scene: The kitchen, Cinderella sitting in the chimney-corner. The youngest sister enters, less rude and uncivil than the eldest.
action: The youngest sister enters the kitchen.
caption: "But the youngest, who was not so rude and uncivil as the eldest, called her Cinderella."

scene: The chimney-corner, Cinderella seated in the ashes. She is called Cinderwench by most, but Cinderella by the youngest.
action: Cinderella sits among the cinders, known by her common name.
caption: "Which made her commonly be called Cinderwench; but the youngest, who was not so rude and uncivil as the eldest, called her Cinderella."

scene: The kitchen, Cinderella in her mean apparel. Despite her ragged clothes, she is a hundred times handsomer than her richly dressed sisters.
action: Cinderella sits in her mean apparel, her beauty shining through.
caption: "However, Cinderella, notwithstanding her mean apparel, was a hundred times handsomer than her sisters, though they were always dressed very richly."

scene: The King's palace, grand and magnificent, with trumpeters announcing news to the court. Messengers carry invitations throughout the kingdom.
action: The King's son announces a grand ball at the palace.
caption: "It happened that the King's son gave a ball, and invited all persons of fashion to it."

scene: The gentleman's house, the sisters receiving the invitation with delight. They cut a very grand figure among the quality.
action: The sisters receive the invitation and are mightily delighted.
caption: "Our young misses were also invited, for they cut a very grand figure among the quality."

scene: The gentleman's house, the sisters busy choosing out gowns, petticoats, and head-clothes. They are wonderfully busy in their preparations.
action: The sisters are wonderfully busy in choosing out such gowns, petticoats, and head-clothes as might become them.
caption: "They were mightily delighted at this invitation, and wonderfully busy in choosing out such gowns, petticoats, and head-clothes as might become them."

scene: The kitchen, Cinderella ironing her sisters' linen. She plaited their ruffles while they talked all day long of nothing but how they should be dressed.
action: Cinderella irons her sisters' linen and plaited their ruffles.
caption: "This was a new trouble to Cinderella; for it was she who ironed her sisters' linen, and plaited their ruffles."

scene: The sisters' room, with fabrics and ribbons scattered about. The eldest sister holds up a red velvet suit with French trimming.
action: The eldest sister holds up her red velvet suit and declares her choice.
caption: "For my part," said the eldest, "I will wear my red velvet suit with French trimming."

scene: The sisters' room, the youngest sister displaying a gold-flowered manteau and a diamond stomacher. The fabrics shimmer in the light.
action: The youngest sister holds up her gold-flowered manteau and diamond stomacher.
caption: "And I," said the youngest, "shall have my usual petticoat; but then, to make amends for that, I will put on my gold-flowered manteau."

scene: The sisters' room, the youngest sister continuing her description. She holds up her diamond stomacher, which is far from being the most ordinary one in the world.
action: The youngest sister displays her diamond stomacher.
caption: "And my diamond stomacher, which is far from being the most ordinary one in the world."

scene: The sisters' room, with a tire-woman adjusting head-dresses. Red brushes and patches from Mademoiselle de la Poche lie on a table.
action: The tire-woman makes up their head-dresses and adjusts their double pinners.
caption: "They sent for the best tire-woman they could get to make up their head-dresses and adjust their double pinners."

scene: The sisters' room, the sisters with red brushes and patches from Mademoiselle de la Poche. They prepare their faces for the ball.
action: The sisters use their red brushes and patches from Mademoiselle de la Poche.
caption: "And they had their red brushes and patches from Mademoiselle de la Poche."

scene: The sisters' room, Cinderella standing between her two sisters as they consult her. She holds a comb and ribbon, ready to help.
action: Cinderella is called to consult on their attire and offers to dress their heads.
caption: "Cinderella was likewise called up to them to be consulted in all these matters."

scene: The sisters' room, the sisters asking Cinderella's advice. She had excellent notions, and advised them always for the best.
action: Cinderella advises them always for the best.
caption: "For she had excellent notions, and advised them always for the best."

scene: The sisters' room, Cinderella offering her services to dress their heads. The sisters are very willing she should do so.
action: Cinderella offers her services to dress their heads.
caption: "Nay, and offered her services to dress their heads, which they were very willing she should do."

scene: The sisters' room, the eldest sister speaking to Cinderella while she styles their hair. The eldest sister asks if Cinderella would be glad to go to the ball.
action: The eldest sister asks Cinderella if she would be glad to go to the ball.
caption: "As she was doing this, they said to her: 'Cinderella, would you not be glad to go to the ball?'"

scene: The sisters' room, Cinderella responding with sadness. She says they only jeer her.
action: Cinderella responds that they only jeer her.
caption: "'Alas!' said she, 'you only jeer me; it is not for such as I am to go thither.'"

scene: The sisters' room, the sisters laughing at Cinderella's expense. They declare it would make people laugh to see a Cinderwench at a ball.
action: The sisters declare it would make people laugh to see a Cinderwench at a ball.
caption: "'Thou art in the right of it,' replied they; 'it would make the people laugh to see a Cinderwench at a ball.'"

scene: The sisters' room, Cinderella finishing the sisters' hair with perfect skill. Despite their unkind words, she dresses them perfectly well.
action: Cinderella dresses their heads perfectly despite their unkind words.
caption: "Anyone but Cinderella would have dressed their heads awry, but she was very good, and dressed them perfectly well."

scene: The sisters' room, the sisters almost two days without eating, so much were they transported with joy. They are excited and animated.
action: The sisters are almost two days without eating, so much were they transported with joy.
caption: "They were almost two days without eating, so much were they transported with joy."

scene: The sisters' room, the sisters struggling to lace themselves into their gowns. They have broken over a dozen laces trying to be laced up close.
action: The sisters try to be laced up close for a fine slender shape, breaking laces.
caption: "They broke above a dozen laces in trying to be laced up close, that they might have a fine slender shape."

scene: The sisters' room, the sisters continually at their looking-glass. They admire their reflections and adjust their attire.
action: The sisters are continually at their looking-glass.
caption: "And they were continually at their looking-glass."

scene: The front of the gentleman's house, morning light. The happy day has come. The sisters depart for the ball in fine carriages.
action: The sisters go to Court while Cinderella follows them with her eyes until she loses sight of them.
caption: "At last the happy day came; they went to Court, and Cinderella followed them with her eyes as long as she could."

scene: The chimney-corner of the kitchen, Cinderella seated among cinders and ashes, weeping. Her tears fall into the ash.
action: Cinderella falls a-crying, her tears streaming down her face.
caption: "When she had lost sight of them, she fell a-crying."

scene: The kitchen, Cinderella weeping in the chimney-corner. Her godmother appears beside her, a fairy with a gentle expression.
action: The fairy godmother asks Cinderella what is the matter.
caption: "Her godmother, who saw her all in tears, asked her what was the matter."

scene: The kitchen, Cinderella sobbing, unable to speak. The fairy godmother listens patiently.
action: Cinderella tries to speak but is interrupted by her tears and sobbing.
caption: "'I wish I could--I wish I could--'; she was not able to speak the rest, being interrupted by her tears and sobbing."

scene: The kitchen, the fairy godmother speaking kindly to Cinderella. The godmother's expression is knowing and warm.
action: The fairy godmother speaks to Cinderella, understanding her wish.
caption: "This godmother of hers, who was a fairy, said to her, 'Thou wishest thou couldst go to the ball; is it not so?'"

scene: The kitchen, Cinderella responding with a great sigh. She confirms her wish to go to the ball.
action: Cinderella confirms her wish with a great sigh.
caption: "'Y--es,' cried Cinderella, with a great sigh."

scene: The kitchen, the fairy godmother promising to help. She gestures toward the garden.
action: The fairy godmother promises to contrive that Cinderella shall go to the ball.
caption: "'Well,' said her godmother, 'be but a good girl, and I will contrive that thou shalt go.'"

scene: The kitchen, the fairy godmother taking Cinderella into her chamber. The godmother's wand is visible in her hand.
action: The fairy godmother takes her into her chamber and sends her to the garden.
caption: "Then she took her into her chamber, and said to her, 'Run into the garden, and bring me a pumpkin.'"

scene: The garden, lush with vegetables and flowers. A large, fine pumpkin sits prominently among the plants. Cinderella approaches it.
action: Cinderella gathers the finest pumpkin she can get from the garden.
caption: "Cinderella went immediately to gather the finest she could get, and brought it to her godmother."

scene: The kitchen, Cinderella bringing the pumpkin to her godmother. She cannot imagine how this pumpkin could make her go to the ball.
action: Cinderella brings the pumpkin to her godmother.
caption: "Not being able to imagine how this pumpkin could make her go to the ball."

scene: The kitchen, the fairy godmother scooping out the inside of the pumpkin, leaving only the rind. The pumpkin's flesh is discarded.
action: The fairy godmother scoops out all the inside of the pumpkin, having left nothing but the rind.
caption: "Her godmother scooped out all the inside of it, having left nothing but the rind."

scene: The kitchen, the fairy godmother striking the empty pumpkin rind with her wand. The pumpkin begins to glow and transform.
action: The fairy godmother strikes the pumpkin with her wand, turning it into a fine coach.
caption: "Which done, she struck it with her wand, and the pumpkin was instantly turned into a fine coach, gilded all over with gold."

scene: The kitchen, a magnificent golden coach now stands where the pumpkin was. Cinderella stares in wonder. The fairy godmother moves to the mouse-trap.
action: The fairy godmother goes to look into her mouse-trap where she found six mice, all alive.
caption: "She then went to look into her mouse-trap, where she found six mice, all alive."

scene: The kitchen, the fairy godmother at the mouse-trap. Cinderella lifts the trapdoor as instructed.
action: The fairy godmother orders Cinderella to lift up a little the trapdoor.
caption: "And ordered Cinderella to lift up a little the trapdoor."

scene: The kitchen, mice emerging from the trap. The fairy godmother touches each mouse with her wand as it goes out.
action: The fairy godmother gives each mouse a little tap with her wand, turning them into horses.
caption: "When, giving each mouse, as it went out, a little tap with her wand, the mouse was that moment turned into a fine horse."

scene: The kitchen, six beautiful mouse-colored dapple-gray horses now stand before the coach. The transformation is complete.
action: The six horses stand ready, a beautiful team of dapple-gray.
caption: "Which altogether made a very fine set of six horses of a beautiful mouse-colored dapple-gray."

scene: The kitchen, the fairy godmother contemplating the need for a coachman. Cinderella speaks up.
action: Cinderella suggests they check the rat-trap for a coachman.
caption: "Being at a loss for a coachman, 'I will go and see,' says Cinderella, 'if there is never a rat in the rat-trap.'"

scene: The kitchen, the fairy godmother agreeing with Cinderella's suggestion. She tells her to go and look.
action: The fairy godmother tells Cinderella to go and look.
caption: "'Thou art in the right,' replied her godmother; 'go and look.'"

scene: The kitchen, Cinderella bringing the rat-trap to her godmother. Inside are three huge rats.
action: Cinderella brings the trap to her godmother, which contains three huge rats.
caption: "Cinderella brought the trap to her, and in it there were three huge rats."

scene: The kitchen, the fairy godmother selecting the rat with the largest beard. She touches it with her wand.
action: The fairy godmother chooses the rat with the largest beard and turns him into a fat, jolly coachman.
caption: "The fairy made choice of one of the three which had the largest beard, and, having touched him with his wand, he was turned into a fat, jolly coachman."

scene: The kitchen, a fat, jolly coachman with magnificent whiskers now stands beside the coach. He has the smartest whiskers eyes ever beheld.
action: The coachman stands proudly, his whiskers gleaming.
caption: "Who had the smartest whiskers eyes ever beheld."

scene: The kitchen, the fairy godmother speaking to Cinderella again. She tells her to go into the garden.
action: The fairy godmother tells Cinderella to go again into the garden.
caption: "After that, she said to her: 'Go again into the garden.'"

scene: The garden, behind the watering-pot, six lizards sit quietly among the plants. Cinderella approaches them.
action: Cinderella finds six lizards behind the watering-pot and brings them to her godmother.
caption: "And you will find six lizards behind the watering-pot, bring them to me."

scene: The kitchen, the fairy godmother touching the lizards with her wand. They transform into footmen.
action: The fairy godmother turns the lizards into six footmen who skip up behind the coach.
caption: "She had no sooner done so but her godmother turned them into six footmen, who skipped up immediately behind the coach."

scene: The kitchen, six footmen in liveries all bedaubed with gold and silver stand behind the coach. They cling close behind each other.
action: The footmen stand in their fine liveries, clinging close behind each other.
caption: "With their liveries all bedaubed with gold and silver, and clung as close behind each other as if they had done nothing else their whole lives."

scene: The kitchen, the complete equipage now assembled: golden coach, six dapple-gray horses, jolly coachman, six footmen. The fairy godmother gestures to it all.
action: The fairy godmother asks Cinderella if she is pleased with the equipage.
caption: "The Fairy then said to Cinderella: 'Well, you see here an equipage fit to go to the ball with; are you not pleased with it?'"

scene: The kitchen, Cinderella looking down at her ragged clothes. She asks if she must go to the ball as she is.
action: Cinderella expresses concern about her dirty rags.
caption: "'Oh! yes,' cried she; 'but must I go thither as I am, in these nasty rags?'"

scene: The kitchen, the fairy godmother touching Cinderella with her wand. Her clothes transform into cloth of gold and silver, beset with jewels.
action: The fairy godmother touches Cinderella with her wand, transforming her clothes into gold and silver cloth with jewels.
caption: "Her godmother only just touched her with her wand, and, at the same instant, her clothes were turned into cloth of gold and silver, all beset with jewels."

scene: The kitchen, Cinderella now dressed in magnificent gold and silver cloth with jewels. The fairy godmother presents a pair of glass slippers.
action: The fairy godmother gives Cinderella a pair of glass slippers, the prettiest in the whole world.
caption: "This done, she gave her a pair of glass slippers, the prettiest in the whole world."

scene: The kitchen, Cinderella stepping up into the golden coach. She is decked out in her finery with the glass slippers on her feet.
action: Cinderella gets up into her coach, ready for the ball.
caption: "Being thus decked out, she got up into her coach."

scene: The kitchen, the fairy godmother standing before the coach, speaking sternly to Cinderella. Her expression is serious and commanding.
action: The fairy godmother commands Cinderella not to stay till after midnight.
caption: "But her godmother, above all things, commanded her not to stay till after midnight."

scene: The kitchen, the fairy godmother continuing her warning. The clock is visible, showing the time approaching evening.
action: The fairy godmother warns Cinderella of the consequences if she stays past midnight.
caption: "Telling her, at the same time, that if she stayed one moment longer, the coach would be a pumpkin again."

scene: The kitchen, the fairy godmother listing the transformations. Her horses would become mice, her coachman a rat, her footmen lizards.
action: The fairy godmother warns that her horses would become mice, her coachman a rat, her footmen lizards.
caption: "Her horses mice, her coachman a rat, her footmen lizards, and her clothes become just as they were before."

scene: The kitchen, Cinderella promising her godmother. She nods with determination.
action: Cinderella promises she will not fail of leaving the ball before midnight.
caption: "She promised her godmother she would not fail of leaving the ball before midnight."

scene: The road to the palace, the golden coach speeding along. Cinderella inside, barely able to contain herself for joy.
action: Cinderella drives away in the coach, scarce able to contain herself for joy.
caption: "And then away she drives, scarce able to contain herself for joy."

scene: The King's palace, grand and ornate, with courtiers and guests gathered for the ball. Music plays as carriages arrive.
action: The King's son runs out to receive the unknown princess.
caption: "The King's son who was told that a great princess, whom nobody knew, was come, ran out to receive her."

scene: The palace entrance, Cinderella alighting from the golden coach. The prince extends his hand to help her down.
action: The King's son gives Cinderella his hand as she alights out of the coach.
caption: "He gave her his hand as she alighted out of the coach, and led her into the ball, among all the company."

scene: The ballroom, elegant with chandeliers and dancing couples. Everyone stops as Cinderella enters. The violins cease to play.
action: The company falls silent, the violins cease to play, all attentive to the newcomer.
caption: "There was immediately a profound silence, they left off dancing, and the violins ceased to play."

scene: The ballroom, guests whispering and admiring Cinderella's beauty. The room buzzes with admiration.
action: Everyone contemplates the singular beauties of the unknown new-comer.
caption: "So attentive was everyone to contemplate the singular beauties of the unknown new-comer."

scene: The ballroom, courtiers murmuring among themselves, all speaking of Cinderella's beauty.
action: The guests exclaim in admiration of Cinderella's beauty.
caption: "Nothing was then heard but a confused noise of: 'Ha! how handsome she is! Ha! how handsome she is!'"

scene: The ballroom, the King and Queen watching from their thrones. The King leans toward the Queen, speaking softly.
action: The King tells the Queen softly that it is a long time since he had seen so beautiful a creature.
caption: "The King himself, old as he was, could not help watching her, and telling the Queen softly that it was a long time since he had seen so beautiful and lovely a creature."

scene: The ballroom, ladies examining Cinderella's clothes and headdress. They note the patterns and fabrics for their own copying.
action: The ladies busily consider Cinderella's clothes and headdress for future copying.
caption: "All the ladies were busied in considering her clothes and headdress, that they might have some made next day after the same pattern."

scene: The ballroom, the ladies noting the fine material and able hands needed to make such clothes. They plan to copy the designs.
action: The ladies note that they might have some made next day after the same pattern, provided they could meet with such fine material.
caption: "Provided they could meet with such fine material and as able hands to make them."

scene: The ballroom, the prince escorting Cinderella to the most honorable seat. She sits gracefully as guests look on.
action: The King's son conducts Cinderella to the most honorable seat.
caption: "The King's son conducted her to the most honorable seat."

scene: The ballroom, the prince and Cinderella dancing together. She moves with grace and elegance, all eyes upon them.
action: The prince takes Cinderella out to dance with him; she dances very gracefully.
caption: "And afterward took her out to dance with him; she danced so very gracefully that they all more and more admired her."

scene: The ballroom, a fine collation served on silver platters. The prince sits across from Cinderella, unable to eat.
action: The prince eats not a morsel, so intently busied in gazing on her.
caption: "A fine collation was served up, whereof the young prince ate not a morsel, so intently was he busied in gazing on her."

scene: The ballroom, Cinderella sitting beside her sisters. They do not recognize her. She shows them civilities.
action: Cinderella goes and sits down by her sisters, showing them a thousand civilities.
caption: "She went and sat down by her sisters, showing them a thousand civilities."

scene: The ballroom, Cinderella offering her sisters oranges and citrons the prince had given her. The sisters accept, puzzled by the stranger's kindness.
action: Cinderella gives them part of the oranges and citrons the Prince had presented her with.
caption: "Giving them part of the oranges and citrons which the Prince had presented her with, which very much surprised them, for they did not know her."

scene: The ballroom, a clock on the wall strikes eleven and three-quarters. Cinderella's eyes widen with alarm.
action: Cinderella hears the clock strike eleven and three-quarters.
caption: "While Cinderella was thus amusing her sisters, she heard the clock strike eleven and three-quarters."

scene: The ballroom, Cinderella rising abruptly from her seat. She makes a courtesy to the company and hurries toward the door.
action: Cinderella makes a courtesy to the company and hastes away as fast as she could.
caption: "Whereupon she immediately made a courtesy to the company and hasted away as fast as she could."

scene: The palace hallway, Cinderella fleeing through the corridors. She runs with urgency toward her coach.
action: Cinderella runs quickly toward her waiting coach.
caption: "She hasted away as fast as she could."

scene: The gentleman's house, Cinderella rushing in, breathless. She seeks out her godmother in the chimney-corner.
action: Cinderella runs to seek out her godmother and thanks her.
caption: "When she got home she ran to seek out her godmother, and, after having thanked her."

scene: The kitchen, Cinderella eagerly telling her godmother what happened at the ball. Her face is animated with excitement.
action: Cinderella tells her godmother she heartily wishes to go next day to the ball.
caption: "She said she could not but heartily wish she might go next day to the ball, because the King's son had desired her."

scene: The kitchen, Cinderella speaking excitedly. A knock sounds at the door.
action: As Cinderella eagerly tells her godmother whatever has passed at the ball, her two sisters knock at the door.
caption: "As she was eagerly telling her godmother whatever had passed at the ball, her two sisters knocked at the door."

scene: The kitchen doorway, the two sisters entering, yawning and stretching. They look tired but satisfied.
action: The sisters enter, gaping, rubbing their eyes and stretching as if just waked.
caption: "'How long you have stayed!' cried she, gaping, rubbing her eyes and stretching herself as if she had been just waked out of her sleep."

scene: The kitchen, the sisters pretending to have slept. They had not, however, any manner of inclination to sleep since they went from home.
action: The sisters stretch and yawn, pretending to have been asleep.
caption: "She had not, however, any manner of inclination to sleep since they went from home."

scene: The kitchen, the sisters describing the ball to Cinderella. They speak of the finest princess, the most beautiful ever seen.
action: The sisters tell Cinderella about the beautiful princess who came to the ball.
caption: "'If thou hadst been at the ball,' said one of her sisters, 'thou wouldst not have been tired with it.'"

scene: The kitchen, the sisters continuing their tale. They describe how the princess showed them civilities and gave them oranges and citrons.
action: The sisters recount the princess's kindness and the prince's admiration.
caption: "'There came thither the finest princess, the most beautiful ever was seen with mortal eyes; she showed us a thousand civilities, and gave us oranges and citrons.'"

scene: The kitchen, Cinderella smiling, asking the name of the princess. The sisters shake their heads, not knowing.
action: Cinderella asks them the name of that princess; they tell her they do not know it.
caption: "Cinderella seemed very indifferent in the matter; indeed, she asked them the name of that princess; but they told her they did not know it."

scene: The kitchen, the sisters describing the prince's uneasiness. He would give all the world to know who she was.
action: The sisters tell how the King's son was very uneasy on her account.
caption: "And that the King's son was very uneasy on her account and would give all the world to know who she was."

scene: The kitchen, Cinderella smiling and asking to borrow her sister's yellow suit of clothes. The eldest sister looks shocked.
action: Cinderella asks to borrow the yellow suit of clothes her sister wears every day.
caption: "At this Cinderella, smiling, replied: 'She must, then, be very beautiful indeed; how happy you have been! Could not I see her? Ah! dear Miss Charlotte, do lend me your yellow suit of clothes which you wear every day.'"

scene: The kitchen, the eldest sister laughing and refusing. She calls Cinderella a dirty Cinderwench.
action: The eldest sister refuses, calling Cinderella a dirty Cinderwench.
caption: "'Ay, to be sure!' cried Miss Charlotte; 'lend my clothes to such a dirty Cinderwench as thou art! I should be a fool.'"

scene: The kitchen, Cinderella smiling at the refusal. She expected such an answer and was glad of it.
action: Cinderella smiles, glad of the refusal for she would have been sadly put to it.
caption: "Cinderella, indeed, expected well such answer, and was very glad of the refusal; for she would have been sadly put to it if her sister had lent her what she asked for jestingly."

scene: The gentleman's house, the next evening. The sisters depart again for the ball in their fine carriages.
action: The two sisters go to the ball again.
caption: "The next day the two sisters were at the ball."

scene: The golden coach arriving at the palace again. Cinderella steps out, dressed more magnificently than before.
action: Cinderella arrives at the ball dressed more magnificently than before.
caption: "And so was Cinderella, but dressed more magnificently than before."

scene: The ballroom, the prince standing always by Cinderella's side. He never ceases his compliments and kind speeches.
action: The King's son is always by Cinderella, never ceasing his compliments and kind speeches.
caption: "The King's son was always by her, and never ceased his compliments and kind speeches to her."

scene: The ballroom, Cinderella enjoying the prince's company. She has forgotten her godmother's warning about midnight.
action: Cinderella quite forgets what her godmother had recommended to her.
caption: "To whom all this was so far from being tiresome that she quite forgot what her godmother had recommended to her."

scene: The ballroom, a clock on the wall strikes twelve. Cinderella's eyes widen in horror. She had thought it no more than eleven.
action: Cinderella counts the clock striking twelve when she had taken it to be no more than eleven.
caption: "She, at last, counted the clock striking twelve when she took it to be no more than eleven."

scene: The ballroom, Cinderella rising suddenly and fleeing. She moves as nimble as a deer through the crowd.
action: Cinderella rises up and flees, as nimble as a deer.
caption: "She then rose up and fled, as nimble as a deer."

scene: The ballroom hallway, the prince following Cinderella. She is too fast and he cannot overtake her.
action: The Prince follows but could not overtake her.
caption: "The Prince followed, but could not overtake her."

scene: The palace staircase, one glass slipper lying on the steps. Cinderella has fled in haste, leaving it behind.
action: Cinderella leaves behind one of her glass slippers.
caption: "She left behind one of her glass slippers, which the Prince took up most carefully."

scene: The gentleman's house, Cinderella arriving home out of breath. She is in her nasty old clothes, with nothing left of her finery but one little slipper.
action: Cinderella gets home quite out of breath, in her nasty old clothes.
caption: "She got home but quite out of breath, and in her nasty old clothes, having nothing left her of all her finery but one of the little slippers, fellow to that she dropped."

scene: The palace gate, the guards being questioned. They stand at attention, reporting what they saw.
action: The guards are asked if they had seen a princess go out.
caption: "The guards at the palace gate were asked if they had not seen a princess go out."

scene: The palace gate, the guards reporting. They saw nobody but a young girl, very meanly dressed, with the air of a poor country wench.
action: The guards report seeing only a young girl, meanly dressed.
caption: "They had seen nobody go out but a young girl, very meanly dressed, and who had more the air of a poor country wench than a gentlewoman."

scene: The gentleman's house, the next morning. The sisters return from the ball and Cinderella asks if they were well diverted.
action: Cinderella asks the sisters if they had been well diverted and if the fine lady had been there.
caption: "When the two sisters returned from the ball Cinderella asked them: If they had been well diverted, and if the fine lady had been there."

scene: The kitchen, the sisters describing the ball. They tell how the princess hurried away at twelve and dropped a glass slipper.
action: The sisters tell how the princess hurried away at twelve and dropped one of her little glass slippers.
caption: "They told her: Yes, but that she hurried away immediately when it struck twelve, and with so much haste that she dropped one of her little glass slippers."

scene: The kitchen, the sisters continuing. The prince had taken up the slipper and done nothing but look at her all the time.
action: The sisters describe the prince's devotion to the beautiful princess.
caption: "The King's son had taken up; that he had done nothing but look at her all the time at the ball, and that most certainly he was very much in love."

scene: The town square, a herald reading a proclamation by sound of trumpet. Citizens gather to hear the announcement.
action: The King's son causes it to be proclaimed that he would marry her whose foot the slipper would just fit.
caption: "For a few days after the King's son caused it to be proclaimed, by sound of trumpet, that he would marry her whose foot the slipper would just fit."

scene: The palace, a nobleman trying the glass slipper on various princesses. Each attempt fails as the slipper does not fit.
action: They begin to try it upon the princesses, then the duchesses and all the Court, but in vain.
caption: "They whom he employed began to try it upon the princesses, then the duchesses and all the Court, but in vain."

scene: The gentleman's house, the slipper brought to the two sisters. They struggle to force their feet into the delicate shoe.
action: The sisters do all they possibly can to thrust their foot into the slipper, but they cannot effect it.
caption: "It was brought to the two sisters, who did all they possibly could to thrust their foot into the slipper, but they could not effect it."

scene: The gentleman's house, Cinderella watching the sisters' failed attempts. She recognizes her slipper and speaks up.
action: Cinderella, who saw all this and knew her slipper, says to them, laughing.
caption: "Cinderella, who saw all this, and knew her slipper, said to them, laughing: 'Let me see if it will not fit me.'"

scene: The gentleman's house, the sisters laughing and bantering Cinderella. They mock her suggestion.
action: Her sisters burst out a-laughing, and begin to banter her.
caption: "Her sisters burst out a-laughing, and began to banter her."

scene: The gentleman's house, the gentleman sent to try the slipper looking at Cinderella. He finds her very handsome and speaks kindly.
action: The gentleman looks earnestly at Cinderella, finds her handsome, and says it was but just she should try.
caption: "The gentleman who was sent to try the slipper looked earnestly at Cinderella, and, finding her very handsome, said: It was but just that she should try, and that he had orders to let everyone make trial."

scene: The gentleman's house, Cinderella sitting down as the gentleman obliges. He puts the slipper to her foot.
action: He obliged Cinderella to sit down, and, putting the slipper to her foot, he found it went on very easily.
caption: "He obliged Cinderella to sit down, and, putting the slipper to her foot, he found it went on very easily."

scene: The gentleman's house, the glass slipper fitting Cinderella's foot perfectly, as if made of wax. The sisters look on in astonishment.
action: The slipper fits her as if it had been made of wax.
caption: "And fitted her as if it had been made of wax."

scene: The gentleman's house, the sisters standing in excessive astonishment. Their faces show shock and disbelief.
action: The astonishment her two sisters were in was excessively great.
caption: "The astonishment her two sisters were in was excessively great."

scene: The gentleman's house, Cinderella pulling the other slipper from her pocket. She puts it on her foot, completing the pair.
action: Cinderella pulls out of her pocket the other slipper and puts it on her foot.
caption: "But still abundantly greater when Cinderella pulled out of her pocket the other slipper, and put it on her foot."

scene: The gentleman's house, the fairy godmother appearing through the door. She touches Cinderella's clothes with her wand.
action: The godmother touches with her wand Cinderella's clothes, making them richer and more magnificent than any she had before.
caption: "Thereupon, in came her godmother, who, having touched with her wand Cinderella's clothes, made them richer and more magnificent than any of those she had before."

scene: The gentleman's house, the sisters recognizing Cinderella as the fine, beautiful lady they had seen at the ball. Their faces show realization.
action: The two sisters find her to be that fine, beautiful lady whom they had seen at the ball.
caption: "And now her two sisters found her to be that fine, beautiful lady whom they had seen at the ball."

scene: The gentleman's house, the sisters throwing themselves at Cinderella's feet. They beg pardon for their ill-treatment.
action: The sisters throw themselves at her feet to beg pardon for all the ill-treatment they had made her undergo.
caption: "They threw themselves at her feet to beg pardon for all the ill-treatment they had made her undergo."

scene: The gentleman's house, Cinderella taking her sisters up and embracing them. Her expression is forgiving and warm.
action: Cinderella takes them up and embraces them, forgiving them with all her heart.
caption: "Cinderella took them up, and, as she embraced them, cried: That she forgave them with all her heart, and desired them always to love her."

scene: The palace, Cinderella conducted to the young prince in her magnificent clothes. He looks at her with admiration.
action: She is conducted to the young prince, dressed as she was.
caption: "She was conducted to the young prince, dressed as she was."

scene: The palace, the prince looking at Cinderella with deep admiration. He finds her more charming than ever.
action: The prince thinks her more charming than ever.
caption: "He thought her more charming than ever."

scene: The palace chapel, a grand wedding ceremony. The prince and Cinderella stand before the altar as a few days after, they are married.
action: A few days after, the prince marries Cinderella.
caption: "And, a few days after, married her."

scene: The palace, Cinderella giving her two sisters lodgings. She embraces them warmly in their new apartments.
action: Cinderella gives her two sisters lodgings in the palace.
caption: "Cinderella, who was no less good than beautiful, gave her two sisters lodgings in the palace."

scene: The palace courtyard, a double wedding celebration. Cinderella's sisters are married to two great lords of the Court. Guests celebrate.
action: That very same day Cinderella matches her sisters with two great lords of the Court.
caption: "And that very same day matched them with two great lords of the Court."

scene: The palace, a grand celebration. Cinderella stands between her sisters, all three now happy and united. The kingdom rejoices.
action: The celebration continues as all are united in happiness.
caption: "Cinderella, who was no less good than beautiful, gave her two sisters lodgings in the palace."

scene: The palace, Cinderella's goodness shining through. She was no less good than beautiful, a princess of unparalleled kindness.
action: Cinderella stands as a testament to goodness and beauty combined.
caption: "Cinderella, who was no less good than beautiful, gave her two sisters lodgings in the palace."
